name: Analytical scans, 1M rows, COLD first-touch (Basin v57 vs Neon free)
claim: The same scans on a COLD first touch — Basin reads from object storage (Tigris) before its cache is warm. The big aggregations still win cold; top_k does NOT (the first-touch object-storage reads dominate). Published honestly. p50 ms, lower is better.

metrics.label: sum(amount), numeric_only — SELECT sum(amount) FROM t
count(DISTINCT tenant_id), wide_pk — SELECT count(DISTINCT tenant_id) FROM t
group_by top20, wide_pk — SELECT tenant_id,count(*),sum(amount) FROM t GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20
top_k, wide_pk — SELECT id,amount FROM t ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 50

note: Cold = first-touch p50 (caches empty, Basin pays the object-storage read). The disaggregated-storage tradeoff: Basin's cache helps repeat reads, not the first miss. top_k loses cold (811ms vs 116ms) even though it wins 3.64x warm — we publish the loss.
